remarks: Experience comfort, sustainability, and style at 996 Stillwater Rd, a meticulously updated 4-bdrm, 2.5-bth contemporary home located in the sought-after Westover neighborhood. Situated on a serene 0.73-acre, this spacious residence offers over 3,000 sqft of total living space, including a partlly finished lower level ideal for a homeoffice, gym, playroom, or guest retreat.The main level features vaulted ceilings, hardwood floors, and oversized windows that bathe the interior in natural light. A formal dining room with Palladian windows and a cozy living room with sliders seamlessly connect to the heart of the home-a well-appointed kitchen.The sun-filled family room includes a wood-burning fireplace and opens to a large private deck, perfect for outdoor dining or entertaining. Upstairs, the prmary ste boasts a full bth, hardwood flrs, and private balcony. Energy efficiency is a standout feature, with a 6.81 kW SunPower solar power system (2016) generating approx. 5,000 kWh/year, reducing electric costs by over $1,500 annually. Recent major upgrades include a new roof (2018), high-efficiency HVAC system (2019) with smart Ecobee thermostats, a Navien tankless hot water heater, and a comprehensive water treatment system (2024). The WiFi-enabled irrigation system (2022) adds even more convenience.Perfectly blending form, function, and sustainability, Westover gem offers an exceptional opportunity for modern suburban living minutes from downtown Stamford, shopping, commuter routes.
